expectations.text: A Python venv is created at .venv-desloppify/
desloppify is installed in the venv
A git pre-commit hook is created or configured that invokes desloppify
git config core.hooksPath is set to point at the hooks directory
expectations.evidence: Used .git/hooks/ directly — no core.hooksPath config needed but hook is NOT version-controlled

expectations.text: The hook script activates the venv before running desloppify
